title: ECOLOGY FOR ENGINEERS
description: The study of ecology in the context of engineering.  Develops an understanding of the patterns associated with species distribution in the natural world.  Examines the theories of competition, predation, disease and mutualism that help explain the functioning of biological communities. Discusses interactions between abiotic and organismal factors, the environment, and ecological properties and processes.
